fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects abuse of the cron utility to perform task scheduling for initial or recurring execution of malicious code. Detection will focus on crontab jobs uploaded from the tmp folder.
fields.name: Scheduled Cron Task/Job - MacOs
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/crontab" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "/tmp/"))
